scripts.build: npm run build -w @log-platform/shared && npm run build -w @log-platform/ingestor && npm run build -w @log-platform/worker && npm run build -w @log-platform/query-api
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "ingestor,worker,query-api,dashboard" --prefix-colors "cyan,green,yellow,magenta" "npm run dev -w @log-platform/ingestor" "npm run dev -w @log-platform/worker" "npm run dev -w @log-platform/query-api" "cd packages/dashboard && ng serve"
